doorbell.title: Eufy Doorbell
install.body: The listener runs on eufy-sdk, an unofficial community library. Installing downloads it from npm into ~/.local/share/omarchy-eufy-doorbell.
install.busy: Installing eufy-sdk. This takes a minute.
install.failed: The install failed. The shell log has the details.
node.body: The listener needs Node.js 24.5 or newer on your PATH, for example through: mise use -g node@lts
account.heading: Use a second eufy account
account.why: eufy allows one login per account at a time. On your own account, the app on your phone and Omarchy would keep logging each other out. Give Omarchy an account of its own:
account.step1: Create a new eufy account with another email address. An alias of your own address works.
account.step2: In the eufy app on your phone, logged in as yourself, open Family & Guests (or Sharing), invite the new address, share the doorbell and its HomeBase, and allow live view.
account.step3: Log in to the app as the new account once to accept the invitation, and check that doorbell notifications are on there. Then log back in as yourself.
account.step4: Log in with the new account here.
form.countryHint: Two letters, the country of the eufy account
form.secret: The password goes to your keyring, the session to ~/.local/share/omarchy-eufy-doorbell.
captcha.body: eufy wants to know you are human. Type the characters in the picture.
captcha.retry: That was not it. Try this one.
twofa.body: eufy sent a verification code to %1.
error.body: The connection to eufy dropped. It retries by itself.
ready.heading: Doorbells
ready.none: This account sees no doorbell yet. Share the doorbell with it in the eufy app, then try again.
